title: Secret/隐私扫描
implementation: tools/secretscan: entropy + pattern + fixture-redaction scanner over git-tracked files (core.quotepath=false keeps CJK documentation paths readable)
four rules: private key blocks, passkey-bearing URLs (entropy >= 3.0 on 20+ char candidates), provider tokens (GitHub/AWS/Google shapes), credential-shaped assignments (entropy >= 3.4 floor)
explicit allowlist (tools/secretscan/allowlist.json) with path-scoped entries and review notes; unit tests cover leak detection, allowlist exemption, path-scoping, and binary mode
make secretscan writes the JSON report under artifacts/
